caption: The drawing depicts a central female figure standing on a cloud with three cherub heads at her feet. She is dressed in a long, white robe with a blue-green cloak flowing around her and has a golden halo with radiating blue light behind her head. Her hands are crossed over her chest and she has a calm facial expression. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame adorned with ornate scrolling decorations in red, gold, and brown, with a stylized shell and floral motifs at the top. In the background, there is a small building with an archway on the left, a palm plant, a green tree on the right, a ladder, a crescent moon, and a small sun against a blue and yellow sky. The figure is the focal point, centered within the frame, and the composition includes various symbolic or decorative elements around her. The colors used are predominantly blue, green, gold, red, and beige, with some areas of brown and pink. The artwork is positioned on a plain, off-white background. The names "R.W.R. TAYLOR" and "W. KRECKHOFF" are written in small letters at the bottom right corner outside the frame.
title: Santo de Retablo (Virgin Mary)
